speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: De Quervain's Tenosynovitis. The history of repetitive strain (holding an infant), pain localized to the radial wrist and thumb base, and positive response to ice are classic signs. The absence of numbness rules out nerve compression, and the normal X-ray excludes a fracture.
